Shell(python -c  from pathlib import Path import re FRONT = re.compile(r'^---\s*
.*?
---\s*
', re.DOTALL) src = Path('../sdlc-suite/agents') dst = Path('agents') mismatch = 0 for s in sorted(src.glob('*.md')): d = dst / s.name sb = FRONT.sub('', s.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) db = FRONT.sub('', d.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if sb != db: mismatch += 1 print(f'BODY MISMATCH: {s.name}') print(f'Checked {len(list(src.glob("*.md")))} agents, {mismatch} body mismatches') )
